originalModelReport.domain: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system for manufacturing and distribution operations
originalModelReport.summary:
This is a comprehensive ERP system that manages order-to-cash and procure-to-pay workflows for manufacturing and distribution companies. The application serves enterprise operations teams including sales managers, procurement officers, warehouse staff, financial controllers, and quality inspectors who execute and monitor business processes daily.

The system provides transaction processing capabilities spanning sales order management, procurement, inventory control, production scheduling, quality management, warehousing, billing, and financial accounting. Users can create and track sales orders, manage purchase orders with suppliers, reserve and move inventory, schedule production runs, conduct quality inspections, generate invoices, process payments, and post financial journal entries. The platform provides analytical views into operations through HANA tables and functions that calculate metrics like order fulfillment status, inventory availability, customer credit exposure, supplier quality performance, and cash flow forecasts.

The system integrates with external partners through standardized interfaces — receiving orders via EDI IDoc and XML, sending delivery confirmations via SOAP, and processing payment notifications via CloudEvents. It enforces business policies for credit approval, purchase authorization, pricing, quality acceptance, and payment terms while maintaining a transaction audit trail through event logging and journal entries. The implementation includes CAP services, ABAP classes with policy evaluation logic, a .NET settlement reconciliation batch job, HANA stored procedures for stock reservation and reconciliation, and integration handlers for inbound messages.

useCases.title: Create and manage sales orders
useCases.description: Sales staff create new customer orders, validate them against credit limits and inventory availability, and track their status through fulfillment. The system checks authorization rules and company policies before accepting orders.
steps: Sales Manager initiates order creation through the order management interface
System validates customer is not blocked and belongs to the company
System validates order lines (1-100 items) with positive quantities and prices
System verifies materials and plants exist
Order is recorded in the SalesOrders entity with unique order ID, status DRAFT, and calculated total
Order items are inserted into SalesOrderItems with material, plant, quantity, and unit price
useCases.evidence: createOrder function in sales.js, enterprise.SalesOrders and SalesOrderItems entities in sales.cds, ZCL_ENT_ORDER ABAP class

useCases.title: Release order for fulfillment
useCases.description: After validating credit and inventory availability, authorized staff release approved orders to trigger warehouse picking and delivery preparation. The system enforces authorization checks, reserves inventory, updates customer credit exposure, and records release events atomically.
steps: Coordinator selects orders ready for release with order ID and expected revision
System validates user has Planner role and company authorization
System performs atomic credit check: customer exposure plus order total must not exceed credit limit
System reserves inventory by decrementing available stock and incrementing reserved stock for each item
Order status transitions from DRAFT to RELEASED with incremented revision
Credit decision, integration event, audit event, and idempotent command record are written in the same transaction
useCases.evidence: releaseOrder function in order-workflow.js, ZCL_ENT_ORDER.release method in ABAP, ZENT_RELEASE report

useCases.title: Create and approve purchase orders
useCases.description: Procurement staff create purchase orders to replenish inventory from suppliers. The system routes orders through approval workflows based on business rules and value thresholds before sending to suppliers.
steps: Procurement Officer creates purchase order with supplier, company, currency, and 1-100 line items
System validates supplier is not blocked and belongs to the company
System validates materials and plants exist for each line item
Purchase order is recorded with status DRAFT and calculated total
Authorized approver (different from creator) reviews and approves the purchase order
System validates segregation of duties: approver cannot be the creator
Order status transitions from DRAFT to APPROVED
useCases.evidence: createPurchaseOrder and approvePurchaseOrder functions in procurement.js, zcl_po_approval_policy.clas.abap policy class, enterprise.PurchaseOrders entity

useCases.title: Receive goods from suppliers
useCases.description: Warehouse staff record goods receipt when materials arrive from suppliers, validate quantities against purchase orders, create quality inspection lots, and update order receipt status.
steps: Warehouse Clerk records goods receipt with purchase order, item, quantity, and batch number
System validates purchase order is approved or partially received
System validates received quantity does not exceed outstanding quantity on the order line
Received quantity is incremented on the purchase order item
Quality lot is created with status OPEN for inspection
Goods receipt record is created linking to purchase order and quality lot
If all items are fully received, purchase order status changes to RECEIVED; otherwise PARTIALLY_RECEIVED
useCases.evidence: receiveGoods function in procurement.js, enterprise.GoodsReceipts and QualityLots entities

useCases.title: Reserve inventory for customer orders
useCases.description: When orders are released, the system automatically reserves available inventory to fulfill customer demand. Stock available quantity is decremented and reserved quantity is incremented atomically.
steps: System receives order requiring inventory reservation during release workflow
For each order line item, system checks available stock at the plant
Available stock is decremented and reserved stock is incremented using atomic UPDATE with WHERE predicate
Stock reservation record is created linking order, material, plant, quantity with status RESERVED
If any line has insufficient stock, the entire transaction rolls back
useCases.evidence: releaseOrder function in order-workflow.js, ZCL_ENT_INVENTORY.reserve method in ABAP, RESERVE_STOCK HANA procedure, enterprise.Reservations entity

useCases.title: Transfer inventory between plants
useCases.description: Warehouse staff transfer stock between plants within the same company. The system decrements stock at the source plant and increments stock at the destination plant atomically.
steps: Warehouse Coordinator initiates stock transfer with material, from plant, to plant, and quantity
System validates both plants belong to the company
Available stock is decremented at the source plant using atomic UPDATE with quantity check
Available stock is incremented at the destination plant (or new stock record created if none exists)
Stock movement record is created with reason TRANSFER
useCases.evidence: transferStock function in inventory.js, enterprise.StockMovements entity

useCases.title: Count and adjust inventory
useCases.description: Inventory controllers conduct physical stock counts and adjust system quantities to match actual quantities, respecting committed reservations.
steps: Inventory Controller records physical count with material, plant, counted quantity, expected revision, and reason
System retrieves current stock record and validates expected revision matches
System validates counted quantity is not less than reserved quantity (cannot discard committed reservations)
Available quantity is set to counted quantity minus reserved quantity
Stock revision is incremented to detect concurrent modifications
Stock movement record is created with the adjustment quantity and reason
useCases.evidence: countStock function in inventory.js, enterprise.Stock and StockMovements entities

useCases.title: Conduct quality inspections on received materials
useCases.description: Quality inspectors test incoming materials from suppliers against specifications. The system records inspection results, blocks defective batches using quality policy rules, and releases approved stock for use.
steps: Quality Inspector validates lot and material against quality lot record created during goods receipt
Inspector conducts physical or laboratory tests per quality specifications
Quality policy evaluates sample size, defective count, and defect rate threshold in basis points
If defect rate exceeds threshold, policy returns QUARANTINE; otherwise ACCEPT
Inspection results are recorded with pass/fail outcome
If failed, batch is blocked; if passed, stock is released for unrestricted use
useCases.evidence: zcl_quality_policy.clas.abap policy class, enterprise.QualityInspections, QualityLots, and QualityFindings entities

useCases.title: Schedule production orders and resource allocation
useCases.description: Production planners create and schedule manufacturing orders to produce finished goods from raw materials. The system checks bill of materials, reserves component stock, and records production orders.
steps: Production Planner creates production order with material, plant, quantity, and planned start/end dates
System validates material, plant, and positive quantity
System retrieves bill of materials valid for the production date
For each component, system calculates required quantity and reserves stock atomically
Production order is recorded with status SCHEDULED
Production component records are created with status RESERVED
useCases.evidence: scheduleProduction function in manufacturing.js, enterprise.ProductionOrders, ProductionComponents, and BillsOfMaterial entities

useCases.title: Complete production and record yield
useCases.description: Production planners confirm production completion, record good and scrap quantities, consume reserved components, and add finished goods to inventory.
steps: Production Planner confirms completion with production order ID, good quantity, and scrap quantity
System validates good plus scrap equals planned production quantity
Production order status transitions from SCHEDULED to COMPLETED
For each reserved component, reserved stock is decremented
Production components status changes from RESERVED to CONSUMED
Good quantity is added to available stock for the finished material at the plant
useCases.evidence: completeProduction function in manufacturing.js, zcl_production_policy.clas.abap policy class, enterprise.ProductionOrders entity

useCases.title: Generate customer invoices for delivered orders
useCases.description: Billing staff generate invoices for shipped orders, applying tax policies and creating draft journal entries for accounts receivable and revenue recognition.
steps: Billing Specialist selects delivered orders ready for invoicing
System retrieves tax policy for customer country and order currency, validates it is effective
System calculates net amount from order total and tax amount using policy rate in basis points
Invoice is recorded with net amount, tax amount, paid amount 0.00, status OPEN, and due date
Order status transitions from SHIPPED to INVOICED with incremented revision
Draft journal entry is created with debit to receivables (110000), credit to revenue (400000), and credit to tax payable (220000) if tax > 0
Journal lines are inserted with currency and amounts
useCases.evidence: invoiceOrder function in billing.js, enterprise.Invoices, JournalEntries, JournalLines, and TaxPolicies entities

useCases.title: Process customer payments and settle invoices
useCases.description: Finance staff receive payment notifications from banks, match payments to open invoices, and post settlement entries to close receivables and update cash balances.
steps: Payment notification is received from bank or payment provider with invoice ID, amount, currency, and bank reference
System validates payment currency matches invoice currency
System checks payment is not already recorded using bank reference deduplication
Payment amount is validated to not exceed outstanding invoice amount (net + tax - paid)
Invoice paid amount is incremented and status changes to PAID if fully settled, otherwise remains OPEN
Payment record is created with invoice link, partner, amount, and settlement timestamp
If invoice is fully paid, customer exposure is decremented by the order total
useCases.evidence: settlePayment function in billing.js, enterprise.Payments entity, zcl_payment_policy.clas.abap policy class

useCases.title: Reconcile bank payments against invoice ledger
useCases.description: Finance controllers run periodic reconciliation processes to match bank payment files against open invoices from a SQL ledger extract, identifying discrepancies and generating settlement reports.
steps: Reconciliation batch job reads bank payment CSV file with transaction ID, invoice ID, company, currency, amount, and value date
System queries SQL ledger for open invoices (status OPEN or PARTIAL) for the company and currency up to the as-of date
Payment records are matched to invoices by invoice ID, aggregating multiple bank payments per invoice
System calculates expected (ledger amount), received (bank total), and difference for each invoice
Outcome is determined: MATCHED (within tolerance), MISSING_PAYMENT (no bank record), UNDERPAID, OVERPAID, or UNMATCHED_BANK (bank payment with no ledger invoice)
Reconciliation report is generated with lines, totals, and exception count, saved as content-addressed JSON file
useCases.evidence: SettlementJob.RunAsync in SettlementJob.cs, Reconciler.Run in Reconciler.cs, BankCsvReader.Read in BankCsvReader.cs, SqlInvoiceLedger.ReadOpenAsync in SqlInvoiceLedger.cs

useCases.title: Post financial journal entries for transactions
useCases.description: Accounting staff post journal entries to record financial impacts of business transactions. The system validates accounting rules, verifies balanced debits and credits using integer minor units, and transitions journals from draft to posted status.
steps: Accountant selects draft journal entry for posting
System retrieves journal and validates user has Accountant role and company authorization
System retrieves journal lines and validates at least 2 lines exist in a single currency
System validates each line has exactly one debit or credit (not both, not neither)
System sums debits and credits using integer minor units and validates they balance
Journal status transitions from DRAFT to POSTED using atomic UPDATE with status predicate
Audit event is recorded with user, action, journal ID, and verification detail
useCases.evidence: postJournal function in finance.js, cents helper for minor unit conversion, enterprise.JournalEntries and JournalLines entities

useCases.title: Evaluate customer credit for order approval
useCases.description: Credit managers review and approve customer orders based on credit limits and current exposure. The system enforces credit policies atomically during order release by checking exposure plus order total does not exceed limit.
steps: Order is submitted for release which triggers credit approval evaluation
System retrieves customer credit limit and current outstanding exposure
Credit policy evaluates whether customer is blocked or exposure plus order total exceeds limit
If approved, customer exposure is incremented by order total using atomic UPDATE with credit limit predicate
If credit limit exceeded, order release is rejected and transaction rolls back
Credit decision is recorded with order ID, decision, exposure before, limit, and reason
useCases.evidence: releaseOrder function in order-workflow.js, zcl_credit_policy.clas.abap policy class, enterprise.CreditDecisions entity

useCases.title: Cancel sales orders and release reservations
useCases.description: Sales staff cancel draft or released orders. The system reverses inventory reservations and customer credit exposure if the order was released.
steps: Sales Manager cancels order with order ID, company, and expected revision
System validates order revision matches expected revision to prevent concurrent modification
Order status transitions from DRAFT or RELEASED to CANCELLED with incremented revision
If order was RELEASED, system retrieves all reservations with status RESERVED
For each reservation, available stock is incremented and reserved stock is decremented atomically
Reservations status changes from RESERVED to CANCELLED
Customer exposure is decremented by order total using atomic UPDATE
useCases.evidence: cancelOrder function in sales.js, enterprise.SalesOrders and Reservations entities

useCases.title: Reconcile order status across systems
useCases.description: Operations staff run reconciliation processes to verify order and event data consistency, identifying discrepancies between operational and integration tables.
steps: Reconciliation job is triggered via ZENT_RECONCILE report or scheduled batch job ZENT_SCHEDULE
System reads orders with status RELEASED from order table
System reads integration events linked to orders from event table
For each released order, system checks if corresponding integration event exists
Discrepancies (released orders without events) are logged
HANA reconciliation procedure inserts results into RECONCILIATION_RESULT table with run ID, entity, expected count, actual count, and timestamp
useCases.evidence: ZENT_RECONCILE report, ZENT_SCHEDULE report, RECONCILE_ORDERS HANA procedure, enterprise.ReconciliationRuns entity

useCases.title: Monitor enterprise operations through control tower
useCases.description: Operations managers access dashboards showing critical business metrics across sales, inventory, production, quality, and finance using analytical views and stored procedures.
steps: Operations Manager logs into control tower web application
Dashboard calls READ_CONTROL_TOWER HANA procedure with company code
Procedure returns order margin data (order ID, revenue, margin) from ORDER_MARGIN analytical view
Dashboard loads data via ControlTower OData service exposing Orders, Materials, Stock, Incidents, and Objectives entities
Manager reviews metrics and exceptions requiring management attention
Manager drills into detailed transactions for investigation
useCases.evidence: READ_CONTROL_TOWER HANA procedure, control-tower.cds service, ControlTower entities, controltower web app manifest.json

useCases.title: Analyze order fulfillment performance and exceptions
useCases.description: Sales analysts review historical and real-time order fulfillment metrics to identify bottlenecks and investigate delayed or problematic orders using analytical fact tables and exception views.
steps: Analyst accesses order fulfillment analytical views
System presents order fact data from ORDER_FACT, ORDER_ITEM_FACT, and DELIVERY_FACT HANA tables
Analyst filters to identify late orders, partial deliveries, or quality holds
FULFILLMENT_EXCEPTIONS view highlights orders requiring intervention
Analyst investigates root causes (inventory shortage, quality block, logistics delay)
Findings are shared with operations teams for corrective action
useCases.evidence: ORDER_FACT, ORDER_ITEM_FACT, DELIVERY_FACT HANA tables, FULFILLMENT_EXCEPTIONS view declaration

useCases.title: Forecast customer payment cash flow
useCases.description: Treasury staff use cash forecasting functions to predict incoming customer payments based on open invoices and cumulative exposure by customer.
steps: Treasury Analyst runs customer cash forecast calculation with company code
CUSTOMER_CASH_FORECAST HANA function queries ORDER_FACT for released orders
System calculates cumulative exposure per customer using window function over ordered transactions
Results are returned with customer ID, order ID, net amount, and cumulative exposure
Forecast results are presented for treasury planning and bank coordination
useCases.evidence: CUSTOMER_CASH_FORECAST HANA function

useCases.title: Assess supplier risk and quality performance
useCases.description: Procurement managers evaluate supplier performance using quality inspection history, delivery reliability, and risk indicators from analytical tables and functions.
steps: Procurement Manager runs supplier risk assessment with supplier ID
SUPPLIER_RISK HANA function retrieves supplier score from SUPPLIER_SCORE analytical table
System calculates risk score using formula: (1 - on-time ratio) * 50 + defect ratio * 100 + lead days * 0.2
Default score of 100 is returned if no data exists
High-risk suppliers are flagged for review or alternative sourcing
Supplier scorecard results inform contract renewal and vendor management decisions
useCases.evidence: SUPPLIER_RISK HANA function, SUPPLIER_SCORE and QUALITY_RESULT analytical tables

useCases.title: Check product availability for order promising
useCases.description: Customer service staff check real-time product availability at specific plants to provide accurate delivery promises to customers.
steps: Customer Service Representative enters material ID and plant code for availability check
AVAILABLE_TO_PROMISE HANA function queries STOCK_SNAPSHOT for available quantity
Function returns available quantity (or 0 if no stock record exists) for the material at the plant
Representative provides customer with confirmed delivery date based on ATP result
useCases.evidence: AVAILABLE_TO_PROMISE HANA function, enterprise.Stock entity

useCases.title: Receive customer orders from external channels
useCases.description: Customers place orders through external e-commerce platforms or B2B portals. The system receives ORDERS05 IDoc messages, validates schemas, resolves external identifiers to internal IDs, and creates sales orders.
steps: Customer submits order through external e-commerce platform or EDI
Integration layer receives ORDERS05 IDoc message via orders05.js handler
IDoc schema is validated (MESTYP=ORDERS, IDOCTYP=ORDERS05, CIMTYP=ZENT_ORDERS05)
External identifiers (sender, IDoc number, customer partner, material IDs) are resolved to internal UUIDs using identifiers module
IDoc line items are transformed to internal order format with material, plant, quantity, unit price
Internal sales order is created via createOrder function with idempotent request ID derived from sender and IDoc number
External identifier mapping is registered for the order
useCases.evidence: receiveOrder function in orders05.js, parseXml and list/scalar helpers in xml.js, identifiers.resolve module, createOrder in sales.js

useCases.title: Send delivery confirmations to logistics systems
useCases.description: After shipping goods, the system sends delivery confirmations to external logistics providers via SOAP interfaces.
steps: Warehouse Clerk records delivery shipment
Integration layer receives ConfirmDelivery SOAP message via delivery-soap.js handler
SOAP body is parsed and validated (one ConfirmDelivery operation, company code matches scope)
External order number is resolved to internal order ID using identifiers module
Shipment is processed via shipOrder function with carrier and tracking number
Idempotent request ID is derived from SOAP message ID to prevent duplicate processing
useCases.evidence: confirmDelivery function in delivery-soap.js, parseXml and scalar helpers in xml.js, identifiers.resolve module

useCases.title: Receive payment notifications from banks
useCases.description: Customers make payments through banks which send CloudEvents payment notifications. The system receives these events, resolves invoice references, and settles payments.
steps: Bank or payment provider sends payment notification via CloudEvents 1.0 webhook
Integration layer receives event via payment-event.js handler
Event is validated (specversion 1.0, type enterprise.payment.received.v1, datacontenttype application/json)
External invoice number is resolved to internal invoice ID using identifiers module
Payment is processed via settlePayment function with amount, currency, and bank reference
Idempotent request ID is derived from CloudEvent source and ID to prevent duplicate processing
useCases.evidence: receivePayment function in payment-event.js, identifiers.resolve module, settlePayment in billing.js

useCases.title: Track and acknowledge operational incidents
useCases.description: IT and operations staff monitor system health and business process execution. When monitoring events occur, staff review, categorize by severity, and acknowledge them for resolution tracking.
steps: Cloud monitoring system detects incident or performance anomaly and sends normalized event
Integration layer receives monitoring event via ingestMonitoringEvent function
Event is validated (severity INFO/WARNING/CRITICAL, service, summary, optional correlation ID)
Event is deduplicated by external event ID; if seen, returns existing incident ID
New incident is created with source CLOUD_ALM_NORMALIZED, severity, summary, status OPEN
Monitoring event record is created linking external event ID to incident ID
System Administrator reviews incident in control tower dashboard
Administrator acknowledges incident via acknowledgeIncident function
Incident status transitions from OPEN to ACKNOWLEDGED with acknowledging user recorded
Audit event is recorded
useCases.evidence: ingestMonitoringEvent and acknowledgeIncident functions in monitoring.js, enterprise.Incidents and MonitoringEvents entities

useCases.title: Analyze profit margins on sales orders
useCases.description: Finance and sales leadership analyze profitability of sales orders by reviewing revenue and margin calculations from analytical views.
steps: Sales Controller accesses order margin analytical view
ORDER_MARGIN HANA view provides order ID, revenue, and margin data
Results are aggregated by customer, product line, or sales region
Low-margin orders are analyzed for pricing optimization or cost reduction opportunities
useCases.evidence: ORDER_MARGIN HANA view used by READ_CONTROL_TOWER procedure

useCases.title: Monitor service level performance and health
useCases.description: Service managers track operational service level objectives (SLOs) and performance metrics using analytical views of service measurements.
steps: Service Manager accesses service health analytical dashboard
SERVICE_HEALTH HANA view retrieves service measurement data from SERVICE_MEASUREMENT table
Current performance is compared against defined SLO thresholds
Services violating SLOs are highlighted for attention
Manager investigates root causes and initiates corrective actions
Trend analysis identifies systemic issues requiring architectural or process changes
useCases.evidence: SERVICE_HEALTH HANA view, SERVICE_MEASUREMENT table, enterprise.ServiceObjectives entity

useCases.title: Register business partners with credit limits
useCases.description: Master data administrators create business partner records for customers and suppliers, assigning initial credit limits and country information.
steps: Administrator creates business partner with company, name, country, and initial credit limit
System validates name (max 120 chars) and ISO country code (2 letters)
Credit limit is converted to integer minor units (cents)
Business partner is recorded with exposure initialized to 0.00, blocked set to false
Partner ID is returned with status ACTIVE and credit limit
useCases.evidence: registerPartner function in master-data.js, enterprise.BusinessPartners entity

useCases.title: Revise customer credit limits
useCases.description: Credit managers update customer credit limits based on payment history and risk assessment, ensuring new limits do not fall below current exposure.
steps: Credit Manager revises credit limit for business partner
System validates new limit is not less than current exposure
Credit limit is updated using atomic UPDATE with concurrent exposure check
Partner ID is returned with status UPDATED and new credit limit
useCases.evidence: reviseCreditLimit function in master-data.js, enterprise.BusinessPartners entity

useCases.title: Block or unblock business partners
useCases.description: Master data administrators block or unblock business partners to prevent or allow transactions with them based on business decisions.
steps: Administrator blocks or unblocks business partner with reason
System validates blocked is boolean and reason is provided
Partner blocked flag is updated
Partner ID is returned with status BLOCKED or ACTIVE and reason detail
useCases.evidence: blockPartner function in master-data.js, enterprise.BusinessPartners entity
